info.name: Paper AI — Push Notifications
info.description:
Push notification endpoints for Paper AI Assistant.

SETUP
1. Import this collection.
2. Open the collection's Variables tab and set `email` and `password` (an admin account for the announce/test calls — admin ids live in Admin:UserIds in appsettings.json).
3. Run "1. Login" — it captures accessToken into the `jwt` variable automatically. Every other request uses it.

ORDER THAT ACTUALLY WORKS
  1. Login
  2. Register device token   <- paste a real ExponentPushToken from the app
  3. Get preferences         <- confirm announcements=false by default
  4. Opt in to announcements
  5. Announce (DRY RUN)      <- check the audience count
  6. Announce (SEND)         <- not undoable

A push can only be DELIVERED to a real device that registered a real token. Steps 5-6 will report audience 0 until step 2 has been done with a genuine token from a development build or TestFlight (Expo Go cannot issue one — remote push was removed from Expo Go in SDK 53).

request.description: Returns { accessToken, refreshToken }. The test script stores accessToken as {{jwt}}.

Attaches this Expo push token to the logged-in account, detaching it from any other account that held it.

Get a real token from the app: it is registered automatically after sign-in on a development build. Expo Go cannot issue one.
Creates defaults on first call. Expect announcements=false — marketing is opt-in only (App Store guideline 4.5.4).

Only the keys you send are changed; omitted ones are left alone.

Other keys: analysisComplete, usageReminders, renewalReminders.

item.name: 5. Send test push (to yourself, admin only)

request.description:
Pushes to the calling account's own registered token.

{ ok: true } means Expo accepted it. { tokenIsDead: true } means the token belongs to a deleted/reinstalled app and has been cleared. 403 means this account is not in Admin:UserIds.

ALWAYS run this first. Returns { audience, sent: 0 } and delivers nothing.

`audience` counts users who have a token AND announcements=true.

Delivers to everyone opted in. There is no recall.

`screen` is optional and deep-links the app when the notification is tapped (e.g. Upload, Paywall).

Dead tokens are cleared automatically, so `sent` can be lower than `audience`.
What the app calls on sign-out, so the next account on a shared device is not reachable at the previous owner's address.
